content: महत्तर {%a.%} Greater, larger <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-रः@} .²1 The principal, chief, or oldest person, the most respectable person; रघुकुलमहत्तराणां वधूः <ls>U. 4</ls>; गृहपतिश्च ममान्तरङ्गभूतो जनपदमहत्तरः <ls>Dk.</ls> .²2 A chamberlain. .²3 A courtier. .²4 The head or the oldest man of a village.
